highlights: Glassmorphism effects with backdrop-filter blur on floating UI panels and navigation components
Subtle border highlights using semi-transparent white (rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)) on cards and containers
Radial gradient spotlight effects on interactive UI elements using mask-image with radial-gradient
Noise/grain texture overlay on video elements and hero sections using animated background pattern
Accent glow effects using rgba(0, 153, 255, 0.22) background with rgba(0, 153, 255, 0.42) borders on interactive states
